en: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
From the starting position, breathe in and begin coming down slowly until the bar touches your middle chest.

After a brief pause, push the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out. Focus on pushing the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position at the top of the motion, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
ko: 플랫 벤치에 누워 팔뚝과 위팔이 90도가 되는 중간 너비로 바를 잡고, 랙에서 들어 팔을 편 채 가슴 위에 고정하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바가 가슴 중앙에 닿을 때까지 천천히 내리세요.
잠깐 멈춘 뒤 숨을 내쉬며 가슴 힘으로 밀어 올리고, 위에서 1초간 가슴을 조이세요. 내릴 때는 올릴 때보다 두 배 천천히 하세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
끝나면 바를 랙에 다시 거세요.
zh: 仰卧在平板凳上，用中等握距（动作中段小臂与上臂约成 90 度）握杠，从架上取下，手臂伸直举在胸部正上方。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到触及胸部中段。
稍停后呼气，用胸肌把杠铃推回起始位置，顶端锁住手臂、挤压胸肌 1 秒。下放时间最好是上推的两倍。
按计划次数重复。
结束后把杠铃放回架上。

en: Lie back on an incline bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on you upper chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: it should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
ko: 인클라인 벤치에 누워 중간 너비로 바를 잡고, 랙에서 들어 팔을 편 채 머리 위로 고정하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바가 윗가슴에 닿을 때까지 천천히 내리세요.
1초 멈춘 뒤 숨을 내쉬며 가슴 힘으로 밀어 올리고, 위에서 가슴을 조이며 1초 버티세요. 내리는 시간은 올리는 시간의 두 배 이상으로 하세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
끝나면 바를 랙에 다시 거세요.
zh: 仰卧在上斜凳上，用中等握距握杠，从架上取下，手臂伸直举在上方。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到触及上胸。
停顿 1 秒后呼气，用胸肌把杠铃推回起始位置，顶端挤压胸肌 1 秒。下放时间至少是上推的两倍。
按计划次数重复。
结束后把杠铃放回架上。

en: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and slowly lay down on the bench.

Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The arms should be perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position. Tip: In order to protect your rotator cuff, it is best if you have a spotter help you lift the barbell off the rack.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your lower chest.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
ko: 디클라인 벤치 끝에 다리를 고정하고 천천히 누우세요.
중간 너비로 바를 잡고 랙에서 들어, 팔이 바닥과 수직이 되게 편 채 고정하세요. 어깨 보호를 위해 보조자가 바를 들어 주면 좋아요.
숨을 들이마시며 바가 아랫가슴에 닿을 때까지 천천히 내리세요.
1초 멈춘 뒤 숨을 내쉬며 가슴 힘으로 밀어 올리고, 위에서 가슴을 조이며 1초 버티세요. 내리는 시간은 올리는 시간의 두 배 이상으로 하세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
끝나면 바를 랙에 다시 거세요.
zh: 把双腿固定在下斜凳末端，慢慢躺下。
用中等握距握杠，从架上取下，手臂伸直并垂直于地面。为保护肩袖，最好请保护者帮你出杠。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到触及下胸。
停顿 1 秒后呼气，用胸肌把杠铃推回起始位置，顶端挤压胸肌 1 秒。下放时间至少是上推的两倍。
按计划次数重复。
结束后把杠铃放回架上。

en: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.

Once at shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. The dumbbells should be just to the sides of your chest, with your upper arm and forearm creating a 90 degree angle. Be sure to maintain full control of the dumbbells at all times. This will be your starting position.

Then, as you breathe out, use your chest to push the dumbbells up. Lock your arms at the top of the lift and squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then begin coming down slowly. Tip: Ideally, lowering the weight should take about twice as long as raising it.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고 허벅지 위에 올린 채 플랫 벤치에 누우세요. 손바닥은 서로 마주 보게 하세요.
허벅지 반동을 이용해 덤벨을 하나씩 들어 어깨너비로 몸 앞에 드세요.
손목을 돌려 손바닥이 발 쪽을 향하게 하세요. 덤벨은 가슴 옆, 위팔과 팔뚝은 90도를 유지하고 항상 덤벨을 통제하세요.
숨을 내쉬며 가슴 힘으로 덤벨을 밀어 올리고, 위에서 1초간 가슴을 조인 뒤 천천히 내리세요. 내릴 때는 올릴 때보다 두 배 천천히 하세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上，仰卧在平板凳上，掌心相对。
借助大腿发力，逐个把哑铃举起，在身前与肩同宽。
转动手腕使掌心朝前。哑铃位于胸部两侧，上臂与小臂成 90 度，全程控制好哑铃。
呼气，用胸肌把哑铃推起，顶端锁住手臂、挤压胸肌 1 秒，再缓慢下放。下放时间最好是上推的两倍。
按计划次数重复。

en: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand atop your thighs. The palms of your hands will be facing each other.
Then, using your thighs to help push the dumbbells up, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.
Once you have the dumbbells raised to shoulder width, rotate your wrists forward so that the palms of your hands are facing away from you. This will be your starting position.
Be sure to keep full control of the dumbbells at all times. Then breathe out and push the dumbbells up with your chest.
Lock your arms at the top, hold for a second, and then start slowly lowering the weight. Tip Ideally, lowering the weights should take about twice as long as raising them.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the dumbbells back on your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to release the dumbbells.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고 허벅지 위에 올린 채 인클라인 벤치에 기대 누우세요. 손바닥은 서로 마주 보게 하세요.
허벅지 반동을 이용해 덤벨을 하나씩 들어 어깨너비로 드세요.
손목을 돌려 손바닥이 앞을 향하게 하세요.
덤벨을 끝까지 통제하면서 숨을 내쉬며 가슴 힘으로 밀어 올리세요.
위에서 팔을 펴고 1초 버틴 뒤 천천히 내리세요. 내릴 때는 올릴 때보다 두 배 천천히 하세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
끝나면 덤벨을 허벅지에 올렸다가 바닥에 내려놓으세요. 이게 가장 안전해요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上，仰卧在上斜凳上，掌心相对。
借助大腿发力，逐个把哑铃举到与肩同宽。
转动手腕使掌心朝前，这是起始姿势。
全程控制好哑铃，呼气，用胸肌把哑铃推起。
顶端锁住手臂停 1 秒，再缓慢下放。下放时间最好是上推的两倍。
按计划次数重复。
结束后先把哑铃放回大腿，再放到地上，这样最安全。

en: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell on each hand resting on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.

Then using your thighs to help raise the dumbbells, lift the dumbbells one at a time so you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width with the palms of your hands facing each other. Raise the dumbbells up like you're pressing them, but stop and hold just before you lock out. This will be your starting position.

With a slight bend on your elbows in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon, lower your arms out at both sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on your chest. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout the movement, the arms should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the shoulder joint.
Return your arms back to the starting position as you squeeze your chest muscles and breathe out. Tip: Make sure to use the same arc of motion used to lower the weights.
Hold for a second at the contracted position and repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고 허벅지 위에 올린 채 플랫 벤치에 누우세요. 손바닥은 서로 마주 보게 하세요.
허벅지 반동으로 덤벨을 하나씩 들어 손바닥을 마주 보게 한 채 어깨너비로 올리세요. 프레스하듯 올리되 팔꿈치가 완전히 펴지기 직전에 멈추세요.
팔꿈치를 살짝 굽힌 채 숨을 들이마시며 가슴이 늘어날 때까지 양팔을 넓은 호를 그리며 옆으로 내리세요. 팔 모양은 고정하고 어깨 관절만 움직이세요.
숨을 내쉬며 가슴을 조여 같은 호를 그리며 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
위에서 1초 버틴 뒤 정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃放在大腿上，仰卧在平板凳上，掌心相对。
借助大腿发力逐个举起哑铃，掌心相对、与肩同宽。像推举一样上推，但在手臂完全伸直前停住。
肘部微屈，吸气，双臂沿大弧线向两侧下放，直到胸部有拉伸感。手臂形状不变，只有肩关节活动。
呼气，挤压胸肌，沿同一弧线把手臂收回起始位置。
在顶端停 1 秒，按计划次数重复。

en: Hold a dumbbell on each hand and lie on an incline bench that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees.
Extend your arms above you with a slight bend at the elbows.
Now rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing you. Tip: The pinky fingers should be next to each other. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe in, start to slowly lower the arms to the side while keeping the arms extended and while rotating the wrists until the palms of the hand are facing each other. Tip: At the end of the movement the arms will be by your side with the palms facing the ceiling.

As you exhale start to bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position by reversing the motion and rotating the hands so that the pinky fingers are next to each other again. Tip: Keep in mind that the movement will only happen at the shoulder joint and at the wrist. There is no motion that happens at the elbow joint.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고 30도 이하로 세운 인클라인 벤치에 누우세요.
팔꿈치를 살짝 굽힌 채 팔을 위로 뻗으세요.
손목을 돌려 손바닥이 몸 쪽을 향하게 하세요. 새끼손가락끼리 닿을 듯 가깝게 두세요.
숨을 들이마시며 팔을 편 채 옆으로 천천히 내리면서 손바닥이 서로 마주 보도록 손목을 돌리세요. 끝에서는 팔이 몸 옆에, 손바닥은 천장을 향해요.
숨을 내쉬며 동작을 거꾸로 해 덤벨을 시작 자세로 올리고 새끼손가락끼리 다시 모으세요. 팔꿈치는 움직이지 말고 어깨와 손목만 쓰세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，仰卧在角度不超过 30 度的上斜凳上。
手臂向上伸出，肘部微屈。
转动手腕使掌心朝向自己，两个小指相靠，这是起始姿势。
吸气，手臂保持伸展向两侧缓慢下放，同时转动手腕至掌心相对。动作末端手臂在身体两侧，掌心朝上。
呼气，反向完成动作把哑铃举回起始位置，再次让小指相靠。只有肩和手腕活动，肘关节不动。
按建议次数重复。

en: To get yourself into the starting position, place the pulleys on a high position (above your head), select the resistance to be used and hold the pulleys in each hand.

Step forward in front of an imaginary straight line between both pulleys while pulling your arms together in front of you. Your torso should have a small forward bend from the waist. This will be your starting position.

With a slight bend on your elbows in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon, extend your arms to the side (straight out at both sides) in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on your chest. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Keep in mind that throughout the movement, the arms and torso should remain stationary; the movement should only occur at the shoulder joint.
Return your arms back to the starting position as you breathe out. Make sure to use the same arc of motion used to lower the weights.
Hold for a second at the starting position and repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 양쪽 도르래를 머리 위 높이에 맞추고 무게를 정한 뒤 손잡이를 하나씩 잡으세요.
두 도르래 사이 가상의 선보다 한 걸음 앞으로 나서며 양팔을 몸 앞으로 모으세요. 상체는 허리에서 살짝 앞으로 숙이세요.
팔꿈치를 살짝 굽힌 채 숨을 들이마시며 가슴이 늘어날 때까지 양팔을 넓은 호를 그리며 옆으로 벌리세요. 팔과 상체는 고정하고 어깨 관절만 움직이세요.
숨을 내쉬며 같은 호를 그리며 팔을 시작 자세로 모으세요.
시작 자세에서 1초 버틴 뒤 정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 把两侧滑轮调到头顶以上的高位，选好重量，双手各握一个把手。
向前迈过两滑轮间的假想直线，同时双臂在身前合拢，上身从腰部略微前倾。
肘部微屈，吸气，双臂沿大弧线向两侧打开，直到胸部有拉伸感。手臂和躯干不动，只有肩关节活动。
呼气，沿同一弧线把手臂收回起始位置。
在起始位置停 1 秒，按计划次数重复。

en: Sit on the machine with your back flat on the pad.
Take hold of the handles. Tip: Your upper arms should be positioned parallel to the floor; adjust the machine accordingly. This will be your starting position.
Push the handles together slowly as you squeeze your chest in the middle. Breathe out during this part of the motion and hold the contraction for a second.
Return back to the starting position slowly as you inhale until your chest muscles are fully stretched.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 등을 패드에 붙이고 머신에 앉으세요.
손잡이를 잡으세요. 위팔이 바닥과 평행이 되도록 머신을 조절하세요.
숨을 내쉬며 가슴 가운데를 조이듯 손잡이를 천천히 모으고 1초 버티세요.
숨을 들이마시며 가슴이 충분히 늘어날 때까지 천천히 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 坐在器械上，背部紧贴靠垫。
握住把手，调整器械使上臂与地面平行。
呼气，缓慢把把手向中间合拢，挤压胸部中间，保持 1 秒。
吸气，缓慢回到起始位置，直到胸肌充分拉伸。
按建议次数重复。

en: Sit down on the Chest Press Machine and select the weight.
Step on the lever provided by the machine since it will help you to bring the handles forward so that you can grab the handles and fully extend the arms.

Grab the handles with a palms-down grip and lift your elbows so that your upper arms are parallel to the floor to the sides of your torso. Tip: Your forearms will be pointing forward since you are grabbing the handles. Once you bring the handles forward and extend the arms you will be at the starting position.
Now bring the handles back towards you as you breathe in.
Push the handles away from you as you flex your pecs and you breathe out. Hold the contraction for a second before going back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of reps.
When finished step on the lever again and slowly get the handles back to their original place.
ko: 체스트 프레스 머신에 앉아 무게를 정하세요.
머신의 발판 레버를 밟아 손잡이를 앞으로 가져와 잡고 팔을 끝까지 펴세요.
손등이 위를 향하게 손잡이를 잡고, 위팔이 몸통 옆에서 바닥과 평행이 되도록 팔꿈치를 드세요. 손잡이를 앞으로 밀어 팔을 편 자세에서 시작하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 손잡이를 몸 쪽으로 가져오세요.
숨을 내쉬며 가슴에 힘을 주고 손잡이를 밀어내세요. 1초 버틴 뒤 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
끝나면 레버를 다시 밟고 손잡이를 천천히 원위치로 돌려놓으세요.
zh: 坐在推胸器上，选好重量。
踩下器械的脚踏杆，把把手带到前方，握住后手臂完全伸直。
掌心向下握住把手，抬起肘部使上臂在躯干两侧与地面平行。把手推到前方、手臂伸直即为起始姿势。
吸气，把把手收回胸前。
呼气，收紧胸肌把把手推出，保持 1 秒后再回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。
结束后再次踩下脚踏杆，慢慢把把手送回原位。

en: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart while holding your torso up at arms length.
Next, lower yourself downward until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.
Now breathe out and press your upper body back up to the starting position while squeezing your chest.
After a brief pause at the top contracted position, you can begin to lower yourself downward again for as many repetitions as needed.
ko: 바닥에 엎드려 양손을 어깨너비보다 넓게 짚고 팔을 펴서 몸을 들어 올리세요.
숨을 들이마시며 가슴이 바닥에 거의 닿을 때까지 몸을 내리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 가슴을 조이고 상체를 시작 자세로 밀어 올리세요.
위에서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 필요한 만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 俯卧在地，双手撑地、间距宽于肩，手臂伸直撑起身体。
吸气，下放身体直到胸部几乎触地。
呼气，挤压胸肌，把上身推回起始位置。
在顶端稍停，按需要重复。

en: Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform. Place hands on edge of bench or platform, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Position forefoot back from bench or platform with arms and body straight. Arms should be perpendicular to body. Keeping body straight, lower chest to edge of box or platform by bending arms.
Push body up until arms are extended. Repeat.
ko: 벤치나 튼튼한 단을 마주 보고 서서, 양손을 어깨너비보다 조금 넓게 가장자리에 짚으세요.
발을 뒤로 빼서 팔과 몸을 곧게 펴세요. 몸을 일직선으로 유지한 채 팔을 굽혀 가슴을 가장자리까지 내리세요.
팔이 펴질 때까지 몸을 밀어 올리고 반복하세요.
zh: 面对长凳或稳固的高台站立，双手撑在边缘，略宽于肩。
双脚后退，手臂和身体伸直。保持身体成一直线，屈臂让胸部下降到台面边缘。
把身体推起至手臂伸直，重复。

en: Lie on the floor face down and place your hands about 36 inches apart while holding your torso up at arms length. Move your feet up to a box or bench. This will be your starting position.
Next, lower yourself downward until your chest almost touches the floor as you inhale.
Now breathe out and press your upper body back up to the starting position while squeezing your chest.
After a brief pause at the top contracted position, you can begin to lower yourself downward again for as many repetitions as needed.
ko: 바닥에 엎드려 양손을 어깨너비보다 넓게 짚고 팔을 펴서 몸을 든 다음, 발을 박스나 벤치 위에 올리세요.
숨을 들이마시며 가슴이 바닥에 거의 닿을 때까지 몸을 내리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 가슴을 조이고 상체를 시작 자세로 밀어 올리세요.
위에서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 필요한 만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 俯卧在地，双手撑地、间距宽于肩，手臂伸直撑起身体，再把双脚放到箱子或长凳上。
吸气，下放身体直到胸部几乎触地。
呼气，挤压胸肌，把上身推回起始位置。
在顶端稍停，按需要重复。

en: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

Ensuring that the dumbbell stays securely placed at the top of the bench, lie perpendicular to the bench (torso across it as in forming a cross) with only your shoulders lying on the surface. Hips should be below the bench and legs bent with feet firmly on the floor. The head will be off the bench as well.

Grasp the dumbbell with both hands and hold it straight over your chest at arms length. Both palms should be pressing against the underside one of the sides of the dumbbell. This will be your starting position. Caution: Always ensure that the dumbbell used for this exercise is secure. Using a dumbbell with loose plates can result in the dumbbell falling apart and falling on your face.
While keeping your arms straight, lower the weight slowly in an arc behind your head while breathing in until you feel a stretch on the chest.
At that point, bring the dumbbell back to the starting position using the arc through which the weight was lowered and exhale as you perform this movement.
Hold the weight on the initial position for a second and repeat the motion for the prescribed number of repetitions.
ko: 덤벨을 플랫 벤치 위에 세워 두세요.
덤벨이 벤치 위에 안정적으로 놓인 걸 확인하고, 벤치와 십자가 되도록 어깨만 벤치에 대고 누우세요. 엉덩이는 벤치보다 낮게, 무릎을 굽혀 발을 바닥에 단단히 딛고, 머리는 벤치 밖으로 두세요.
양손으로 덤벨을 잡아 팔을 편 채 가슴 위로 드세요. 양 손바닥으로 덤벨 한쪽 원판 안쪽을 받치세요. 원판이 헐거운 덤벨은 얼굴로 떨어질 수 있으니 꼭 고정된 걸 쓰세요.
팔을 편 채 숨을 들이마시며 가슴이 늘어날 때까지 머리 뒤로 호를 그리며 천천히 내리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 같은 호를 그리며 덤벨을 시작 자세로 가져오세요.
시작 자세에서 1초 버틴 뒤 정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 把一只哑铃竖放在平板凳上。
确认哑铃在凳面上放稳，身体与长凳垂直、呈十字，只让肩部躺在凳上。臀部低于凳面，屈膝双脚踩稳地面，头部悬在凳外。
双手握住哑铃，手臂伸直举在胸部上方，双掌托住哑铃一端的内侧，这是起始姿势。务必使用片固定好的哑铃，松动的哑铃可能散开砸到脸上。
手臂保持伸直，吸气，沿弧线把哑铃缓慢放到头后，直到胸部有拉伸感。
呼气，沿同一弧线把哑铃拉回起始位置。
在起始位置停 1 秒，按计划次数重复。

en: Stand in front of a loaded barbell.

While keeping the back as straight as possible, bend your knees, bend forward and grasp the bar using a medium (shoulder width) overhand grip. This will be the starting position of the exercise. Tip: If it is difficult to hold on to the bar with this grip, alternate your grip or use wrist straps.

While holding the bar, start the lift by pushing with your legs while simultaneously getting your torso to the upright position as you breathe out. In the upright position, stick your chest out and contract the back by bringing the shoulder blades back. Think of how the soldiers in the military look when they are in standing in attention.

Go back to the starting position by bending at the knees while simultaneously leaning the torso forward at the waist while keeping the back straight. When the weights on the bar touch the floor you are back at the starting position and ready to perform another repetition.
Perform the amount of repetitions prescribed in the program.
ko: 원판을 끼운 바벨 앞에 서세요.
등을 최대한 곧게 편 채 무릎을 굽히고 상체를 숙여, 어깨너비 오버핸드 그립으로 바를 잡으세요. 그립이 버거우면 얼터네이트 그립이나 스트랩을 쓰세요.
숨을 내쉬며 다리로 바닥을 밀면서 동시에 상체를 세우세요. 다 일어서면 가슴을 펴고 견갑골을 뒤로 모으세요. 차렷 자세의 군인을 떠올리세요.
등을 곧게 유지한 채 무릎을 굽히고 허리에서 상체를 숙여 내려가세요. 원판이 바닥에 닿으면 다음 반복을 준비하세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 站在装好杠铃片的杠铃前。
背部尽量挺直，屈膝俯身，用与肩同宽的正握握杠。如果握不住，可以用正反握或助力带。
呼气，双腿蹬地，同时把躯干直立起来。站直后挺胸，向后收紧肩胛骨，像军人立正一样。
保持背部挺直，屈膝并从腰部前倾回到起始位置。杠铃片触地后准备下一次。
按计划次数完成。

en: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than your shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

Pull your torso up until the bar touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 손바닥이 앞을 향하게 철봉을 잡으세요. 와이드 그립은 어깨너비보다 넓게, 미디엄은 어깨너비로, 클로즈는 어깨너비보다 좁게 잡아요.
팔을 편 채 매달려 상체를 30도쯤 뒤로 젖히고, 허리를 살짝 아치형으로 만들며 가슴을 내미세요.
숨을 내쉬며 어깨와 위팔을 아래·뒤로 당겨 바가 윗가슴에 닿을 때까지 몸을 끌어올리세요. 꼭대기에서 등을 조이고, 상체는 고정한 채 팔만 움직이며 팔뚝은 바를 잡는 데만 쓰세요.
1초 버틴 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 팔이 완전히 펴지고 광배가 늘어날 때까지 천천히 내려오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 掌心朝前握住单杠。宽握距大于肩宽，中握距与肩同宽，窄握距小于肩宽。
双臂伸直悬挂，上身后仰约 30 度，下背微微反弓，挺胸。
呼气，把肩膀和上臂向下、向后拉，把身体拉起直到横杠触及上胸。顶端收紧背部，上身稳定只动手臂，小臂只负责握杠。
保持 1 秒后吸气，缓慢下放，直到手臂完全伸直、背阔肌充分拉伸。
按计划次数重复。

en: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing your torso and a grip closer than the shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, keep your torso as straight as possible while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position. Tip: Keeping the torso as straight as possible maximizes biceps stimulation while minimizing back involvement.

As you breathe out, pull your torso up until your head is around the level of the pull-up bar. Concentrate on using the biceps muscles in order to perform the movement. Keep the elbows close to your body. Tip: The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.

After a second of squeezing the biceps in the contracted position, slowly lower your torso back to the starting position; when your arms are fully extended. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 손바닥이 몸 쪽을 향하게, 어깨너비보다 좁게 철봉을 잡으세요.
팔을 편 채 매달려 상체를 최대한 곧게 세우고, 허리를 살짝 아치형으로 만들며 가슴을 내미세요. 상체를 곧게 세울수록 등보다 이두근을 더 써요.
숨을 내쉬며 머리가 바 높이에 올 때까지 몸을 끌어올리세요. 이두근에 집중하고 팔꿈치는 몸에 붙이세요. 상체는 고정한 채 팔만 움직이세요.
꼭대기에서 1초간 이두근을 조인 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 팔이 완전히 펴질 때까지 천천히 내려오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 掌心朝向自己，以窄于肩宽的握距握住单杠。
双臂伸直悬挂，上身尽量挺直，下背微微反弓，挺胸。上身越直，越能刺激肱二头肌、减少背部参与。
呼气，把身体拉起直到头部与横杠齐平。专注用肱二头肌发力，肘部贴近身体，上身稳定只动手臂。
在顶端挤压肱二头肌 1 秒，然后吸气，缓慢下放直到手臂完全伸直。
按计划次数重复。

en: Choke the band around the center of the pullup bar. You can use different bands to provide varying levels of assistance.
Pull the end of the band down, and place one bent knee into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out. Take a medium to wide grip on the bar. This will be your starting position.

Pull yourself upward by contracting the lats as you flex the elbow. The elbow should be driven to your side. Pull to the front, attempting to get your chin over the bar. Avoid swinging or jerking movements.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
ko: 밴드를 철봉 가운데에 감아 고정하세요. 밴드 강도에 따라 도움 정도가 달라져요.
밴드 끝을 아래로 당겨 한쪽 무릎을 굽혀 고리에 넣고, 빠지지 않는지 확인하세요. 철봉은 중간에서 넓은 너비로 잡으세요.
팔꿈치를 굽히며 광배를 수축해 몸을 끌어올리세요. 팔꿈치는 옆구리로 당기고, 턱이 바를 넘도록 앞쪽으로 당기세요. 몸을 흔들거나 반동을 쓰지 마세요.
잠깐 멈춘 뒤 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
zh: 把弹力带套在单杠中间并拉紧。不同弹力带提供不同的助力。
把弹力带下端拉下来，一侧屈膝放进圈里，确认不会滑出。用中宽握距握杠，这是起始姿势。
屈肘、收缩背阔肌把身体拉起，肘部向身体两侧下拉，尽量让下巴过杠。不要摆动或借力。
稍停后回到起始位置。

en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull down the bar using the forearms.

After a second at the contracted position squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 위 도르래에 긴 바를 건 랫풀다운 머신에 앉아, 키에 맞게 무릎 패드를 조절하세요. 패드가 몸이 딸려 올라가는 걸 막아줘요.
손바닥이 앞을 향하게 바를 잡으세요. 와이드는 어깨너비보다 넓게, 미디엄은 어깨너비, 클로즈는 그보다 좁게 잡아요.
팔을 편 채 상체를 30도쯤 뒤로 젖히고, 허리를 살짝 아치형으로 만들며 가슴을 내미세요.
숨을 내쉬며 어깨와 위팔을 아래·뒤로 당겨 바가 윗가슴에 닿게 내리세요. 끝에서 등을 조이고, 상체는 고정한 채 팔만 움직이며 팔뚝 힘으로 당기지 마세요.
견갑골을 모은 채 1초 버틴 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 팔이 완전히 펴지고 광배가 늘어날 때까지 바를 천천히 올리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 坐在上滑轮挂着长杆的下拉器上，按身高调好膝垫，防止身体被重量带起。
掌心朝前握杆。宽握距大于肩宽，中握距与肩同宽，窄握距小于肩宽。
双臂伸直，上身后仰约 30 度，下背微微反弓，挺胸。
呼气，把肩膀和上臂向下、向后拉，把横杆拉到上胸。底部收紧背部，上身稳定只动手臂，不要用小臂发力下拉。
夹紧肩胛骨保持 1 秒，吸气，缓慢让横杆回到起始位置，直到手臂完全伸直、背阔肌充分拉伸。
按计划次数重复。

en: Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.

Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than your shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you - while holding the bar at the chosen grip width - bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary (only the arms should move). The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull the bar down using the forearms.

After a second in the contracted position, while squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 위 도르래에 바를 건 랫풀다운 머신에 앉아, 키에 맞게 무릎 패드를 조절하세요.
손바닥이 앞을 향하게 어깨너비보다 좁게 바를 잡으세요.
팔을 편 채 상체를 30도쯤 뒤로 젖히고, 허리를 살짝 아치형으로 만들며 가슴을 내미세요.
숨을 내쉬며 어깨와 위팔을 아래·뒤로 당겨 바가 윗가슴에 닿게 내리세요. 상체는 고정한 채 팔만 움직이고, 팔뚝 힘으로 당기지 마세요.
견갑골을 모은 채 1초 버틴 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 팔이 완전히 펴지고 광배가 늘어날 때까지 바를 천천히 올리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 坐在上滑轮挂着横杆的下拉器上，按身高调好膝垫。
掌心朝前，以窄于肩宽的握距握杆。
双臂伸直，上身后仰约 30 度，下背微微反弓，挺胸。
呼气，把肩膀和上臂向下、向后拉，把横杆拉到上胸。上身稳定只动手臂，不要用小臂发力。
夹紧肩胛骨保持 1 秒，吸气，缓慢让横杆回到起始位置，直到手臂完全伸直、背阔肌充分拉伸。
按计划次数重复。

en: You will start by grabbing the wide bar from the top pulley of a pulldown machine and using a wider than shoulder-width pronated (palms down) grip. Step backwards two feet or so.

Bend your torso forward at the waist by around 30-degrees with your arms fully extended in front of you and a slight bend at the elbows. If your arms are not fully extended then you need to step a bit more backwards until they are. Once your arms are fully extended and your torso is slightly bent at the waist, tighten the lats and then you are ready to begin.
While keeping the arms straight, pull the bar down by contracting the lats until your hands are next to the side of the thighs. Breathe out as you perform this step.
While keeping the arms straight, go back to the starting position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 랫풀다운 머신 위 도르래의 긴 바를 어깨너비보다 넓게 오버핸드로 잡고, 60cm쯤 뒤로 물러나세요.
팔을 앞으로 뻗고 팔꿈치는 살짝 굽힌 채 허리에서 상체를 30도쯤 숙이세요. 팔이 다 펴지지 않으면 조금 더 물러나세요. 광배에 힘을 주면 준비 끝이에요.
팔을 편 채 숨을 내쉬며 광배를 수축해 손이 허벅지 옆에 올 때까지 바를 내리세요.
팔을 편 채 숨을 들이마시며 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 用宽于肩的正握握住下拉器上滑轮的长杆，后退约 60 厘米。
双臂向前伸直、肘部微屈，上身从腰部前倾约 30 度。手臂没伸直就再后退一点。收紧背阔肌，准备开始。
手臂保持伸直，呼气，收缩背阔肌把横杆压到大腿两侧。
手臂保持伸直，吸气，回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: For this exercise you will need access to a low pulley row machine with a V-bar. Note: The V-bar will enable you to have a neutral grip where the palms of your hands face each other. To get into the starting position, first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked.
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the V-bar handles.

With your arms extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lats as you hold the bar in front of you. This is the starting position of the exercise.

Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it until you touch the abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: V바를 단 로우 머신에 앉아 발을 발판에 올리고, 무릎은 잠그지 말고 살짝 굽히세요. V바는 손바닥이 서로 마주 보는 그립이에요.
등의 자연스러운 곡선을 유지한 채 앞으로 숙여 V바 손잡이를 잡으세요.
팔을 편 채 상체가 다리와 90도가 될 때까지 뒤로 당겨 앉으세요. 등은 살짝 아치, 가슴은 내밀고 광배가 늘어나는 걸 느끼세요.
상체를 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 팔을 몸에 붙여 손잡이를 배에 닿을 때까지 당기세요. 등을 강하게 조여 1초 버틴 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 천천히 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 坐在装有 V 形把手的低位划船器上，双脚踩在踏板上，膝盖微屈不要锁死。V 形把手让掌心相对。
保持背部自然曲线，前倾握住 V 形把手。
手臂伸直，向后坐直到躯干与双腿成 90 度。背部微弓、挺胸，感受背阔肌的拉伸，这是起始姿势。
躯干不动，呼气，手臂贴近身体把把手拉到腹部。用力收紧背部保持 1 秒，再吸气缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Holding a barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing down), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The barbell should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.

Now, while keeping the torso stationary, breathe out and lift the barbell to you. Keep the elbows close to the body and only use the forearms to hold the weight. At the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 오버핸드로 바벨을 잡고 무릎을 살짝 굽힌 채, 등을 곧게 펴고 상체가 바닥과 거의 평행이 될 때까지 허리에서 숙이세요. 고개는 들고, 바벨은 팔이 수직으로 늘어진 채 몸 앞에 매달려요.
상체를 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 바벨을 몸 쪽으로 당기세요. 팔꿈치는 몸에 붙이고, 꼭대기에서 등을 조이며 잠깐 멈추세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바벨을 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 正握杠铃，膝盖微屈，背部挺直，从腰部前倾直到上身几乎与地面平行。抬头，手臂垂直下垂，杠铃悬在身前。
躯干不动，呼气，把杠铃拉向身体。肘部贴近身体，顶端收紧背部稍停。
吸气，缓慢把杠铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Choose a flat bench and place a dumbbell on each side of it.

Place the right leg on top of the end of the bench, bend your torso forward from the waist until your upper body is parallel to the floor, and place your right hand on the other end of the bench for support.

Use the left hand to pick up the dumbbell on the floor and hold the weight while keeping your lower back straight. The palm of the hand should be facing your torso. This will be your starting position.

Pull the resistance straight up to the side of your chest, keeping your upper arm close to your side and keeping the torso stationary. Breathe out as you perform this step. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. Also, make sure that the force is performed with the back muscles and not the arms. Finally, the upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the dumbbell; therefore do not try to pull the dumbbell up using the forearms.
Lower the resistance straight down to the starting position. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat the movement for the specified amount of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat again with the other arm.
ko: 플랫 벤치 양옆에 덤벨을 하나씩 두세요.
오른쪽 무릎을 벤치 끝에 올리고, 상체가 바닥과 평행이 될 때까지 숙인 뒤 오른손으로 벤치 반대쪽을 짚으세요.
왼손으로 바닥의 덤벨을 들고 허리를 곧게 유지하세요. 손바닥은 몸 쪽을 향해요.
숨을 내쉬며 위팔을 옆구리에 붙인 채 덤벨을 가슴 옆까지 곧게 당기세요. 팔이 아니라 등 근육으로 당기고, 상체는 고정하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 덤벨을 곧게 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
반대쪽으로 바꿔 같은 방법으로 하세요.
zh: 在平板凳两侧各放一只哑铃。
右膝跪在凳子一端，上身前倾到与地面平行，右手撑在凳子另一端。
左手从地上拿起哑铃，保持下背挺直，掌心朝向身体，这是起始姿势。
呼气，上臂贴近体侧，把哑铃竖直拉到胸部侧面。用背部而不是手臂发力，躯干保持不动。
吸气，把哑铃竖直放回起始位置。
按计划次数重复。
换另一侧手臂重复。

en: With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing your torso), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward by bending at the waist; as you bend make sure to keep your back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Tip: Make sure that you keep the head up. The weights should hang directly in front of you as your arms hang perpendicular to the floor and your torso. This is your starting position.

While keeping the torso stationary, lift the dumbbells to your side (as you breathe out), keeping the elbows close to the body (do not exert any force with the forearm other than holding the weights). On the top contracted position, squeeze the back muscles and hold for a second.
Slowly lower the weight again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고(손바닥은 몸 쪽) 무릎을 살짝 굽힌 채, 등을 곧게 펴고 상체가 바닥과 거의 평행이 될 때까지 허리에서 숙이세요. 고개는 들고, 덤벨은 팔이 수직으로 늘어진 채 몸 앞에 매달려요.
상체를 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 팔꿈치를 몸에 붙여 덤벨을 옆구리로 당기세요. 팔뚝은 덤벨을 잡는 데만 쓰고, 꼭대기에서 등을 조이며 1초 버티세요.
숨을 들이마시며 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃（掌心朝向身体），膝盖微屈，背部挺直，从腰部前倾直到上身几乎与地面平行。抬头，手臂垂直下垂，哑铃悬在身前。
躯干不动，呼气，肘部贴近身体把哑铃拉到体侧。小臂只负责握住哑铃，顶端收紧背部保持 1 秒。
吸气，缓慢放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Position a bar into a landmine or in a corner to keep it from moving. Load an appropriate weight onto your end.
Stand over the bar, and position a Double D row handle around the bar next to the collar. Using your hips and legs, rise to a standing position.
Assume a wide stance with your hips back and your chest up. Your arms should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Pull the weight to your upper abdomen by retracting the shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Do not jerk the weight or cheat during the movement.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
ko: 바 한쪽 끝을 랜드마인이나 구석에 고정하고, 반대쪽 끝에 적당한 무게를 끼우세요.
바를 다리 사이에 두고 서서 칼라 바로 옆에 V 손잡이를 거세요. 엉덩이와 다리 힘으로 일어서세요.
발을 넓게 벌리고 엉덩이는 뒤로, 가슴은 들고 팔을 펴세요.
견갑골을 모으고 팔꿈치를 굽혀 무게를 윗배 쪽으로 당기세요. 반동을 쓰지 마세요.
잠깐 멈춘 뒤 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
zh: 把杠铃一端插进地雷架或抵在墙角固定，另一端装上合适的重量。
跨站在杠铃上方，把双 D 形划船把手套在杠铃片卡扣旁，用髋部和腿部发力站起。
宽站距，臀部后坐，挺胸，手臂伸直，这是起始姿势。
收紧肩胛骨、屈肘，把重量拉向上腹部。不要猛拉或借力。
稍停后回到起始位置。

en: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that the handles are at chest level. Grasp the handles with either a neutral or pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your shoulder blades as you flex the elbow.

Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handles to the starting position. For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the muscles being worked.
ko: 적당한 무게를 끼우고, 손잡이가 가슴 높이에 오도록 의자 높이를 조절하세요. 손잡이는 뉴트럴이나 오버핸드 그립으로 잡으세요.
견갑골을 모으고 팔꿈치를 굽혀 손잡이를 몸 쪽으로 당기세요.
끝에서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 천천히 시작 자세로 돌려보내세요. 연속 반복할 땐 무게를 완전히 내려놓지 말고 긴장을 유지하세요.
zh: 装好合适的重量，调整座椅高度使把手与胸部齐平，用对握或正握握住把手，这是起始姿势。
收紧肩胛骨、屈肘，把把手拉向身体。
在末端稍停，再缓慢回到起始位置。连续做时不要让配重完全落回，保持肌肉张力。

en: Position a bar in a rack to about waist height. You can also use a smith machine.

Take a wider than shoulder width grip on the bar and position yourself hanging underneath the bar. Your body should be straight with your heels on the ground with your arms fully extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your chest towards the bar. Retract your shoulder blades as you perform the movement.
Pause at the top of the motion, and return yourself to the start position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
ko: 랙에 바를 허리 높이쯤 걸어 두세요. 스미스 머신을 써도 돼요.
어깨너비보다 넓게 바를 잡고 바 아래에 매달리세요. 몸은 곧게, 뒤꿈치는 바닥에, 팔은 끝까지 펴세요.
팔꿈치를 굽혀 가슴을 바 쪽으로 당기며 견갑골을 모으세요.
꼭대기에서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
원하는 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 把横杆放在深蹲架上约腰部高度，也可以用史密斯机。
以宽于肩的握距握杆，身体悬在杆下。身体挺直、脚跟着地、手臂完全伸直，这是起始姿势。
屈肘把胸部拉向横杆，同时收紧肩胛骨。
在顶端稍停，回到起始位置。
按需要的次数重复。

en: Lie face down on a hyperextension bench, tucking your ankles securely under the footpads.
Adjust the upper pad if possible so your upper thighs lie flat across the wide pad, leaving enough room for you to bend at the waist without any restriction.

With your body straight, cross your arms in front of you (my preference) or behind your head. This will be your starting position. Tip: You can also hold a weight plate for extra resistance in front of you under your crossed arms.

Start bending forward slowly at the waist as far as you can while keeping your back flat. Inhale as you perform this movement. Keep moving forward until you feel a nice stretch on the hamstrings and you can no longer keep going without a rounding of the back. Tip: Never round the back as you perform this exercise. Also, some people can go farther than others. The key thing is that you go as far as your body allows you to without rounding the back.

Slowly raise your torso back to the initial position as you inhale. Tip: Avoid the temptation to arch your back past a straight line. Also, do not swing the torso at any time in order to protect the back from injury.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 백 익스텐션 벤치에 엎드려 발목을 발 패드 아래에 단단히 거세요.
가능하면 위 패드를 조절해 허벅지 윗부분이 패드에 닿고, 허리를 자유롭게 굽힐 공간이 있게 하세요.
몸을 곧게 편 채 팔을 가슴 앞에서 교차하거나 머리 뒤에 두세요. 더 무겁게 하려면 교차한 팔 아래로 원판을 안으세요.
숨을 들이마시며 등을 평평하게 유지한 채 허리에서 천천히 숙이세요. 햄스트링이 늘어나고 등이 굽기 직전까지만 내려가세요. 등은 절대 말지 마세요.
천천히 상체를 시작 자세로 올리세요. 몸이 일직선을 넘어 젖혀지지 않게 하고, 반동을 쓰지 마세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 俯卧在山羊挺身凳上，把脚踝牢牢勾在脚垫下。
如有可能调整上垫，让大腿上部平放在宽垫上，并留出足够空间让腰部自由弯曲。
身体伸直，双臂交叉在胸前或放在脑后，这是起始姿势。想加重可以在交叉的手臂下抱一片杠铃片。
吸气，保持背部平直，从腰部缓慢前屈，直到腘绳肌有拉伸感、再往下背就要弓起为止。全程不要弓背。
缓慢把上身抬回起始位置。不要超过直线过度后仰，也不要甩动躯干。
按建议次数重复。

en: Stand up straight with your feet at shoulder width as you hold a barbell with both hands in front of you using a pronated grip (palms facing the thighs). Tip: Your hands should be a little wider than shoulder width apart. You can use wrist wraps for this exercise for a better grip. This will be your starting position.
Raise your shoulders up as far as you can go as you breathe out and hold the contraction for a second. Tip: Refrain from trying to lift the barbell by using your biceps.
Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 발을 어깨너비로 벌리고 바로 서서, 손등이 앞을 향하게 바벨을 몸 앞에 드세요. 손은 어깨너비보다 조금 넓게 잡고, 필요하면 스트랩을 쓰세요.
숨을 내쉬며 어깨를 최대한 높이 끌어올리고 1초 버티세요. 이두근으로 들지 마세요.
숨을 들이마시며 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双脚与肩同宽站直，正握杠铃置于身前（掌心朝向大腿）。握距略宽于肩，可用助力带辅助握力。
呼气，把肩膀尽量向上耸起，保持 1 秒。不要用肱二头肌提杠铃。
吸气，缓慢回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Start by placing a barbell that is about chest high on a squat rack. Once you have selected the weights, grab the barbell using a pronated (palms facing forward) grip. Make sure to grip the bar wider than shoulder width apart from each other.
Slightly bend the knees and place the barbell on your collar bone. Lift the barbell up keeping it lying on your chest. Take a step back and position your feet shoulder width apart from each other.

Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip length, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Hold at about shoulder level and slightly in front of your head. This is your starting position.
Lower the bar down to the collarbone slowly as you inhale.
Lift the bar back up to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 스쿼트 랙에 바벨을 가슴 높이로 걸고, 무게를 끼운 뒤 손바닥이 앞을 향하게 어깨너비보다 넓게 잡으세요.
무릎을 살짝 굽혀 바벨을 쇄골 위에 얹고 들어 올리세요. 한 걸음 물러나 발을 어깨너비로 벌리세요.
팔을 펴서 바를 머리 위로 들어 올리세요. 머리보다 살짝 앞에서 시작하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바를 쇄골까지 천천히 내리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 바를 시작 자세로 밀어 올리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 把杠铃挂在深蹲架上约胸部高度，装好重量后，掌心朝前、以宽于肩的握距握杠。
微屈膝，把杠铃架在锁骨上取下，后退一步，双脚与肩同宽。
锁住手臂把杠铃举过头顶，位于头部略前方，这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢把杠铃放到锁骨位置。
呼气，把杠铃推回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: While holding a dumbbell in each hand, sit on a military press bench or utility bench that has back support. Place the dumbbells upright on top of your thighs.
Now raise the dumbbells to shoulder height one at a time using your thighs to help propel them up into position.
Make sure to rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. This is your starting position.
Now, exhale and push the dumbbells upward until they touch at the top.
Then, after a brief pause at the top contracted position, slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고 등받이가 있는 벤치에 앉아, 덤벨을 허벅지 위에 세워 두세요.
허벅지 반동으로 덤벨을 하나씩 어깨 높이까지 올리세요.
손목을 돌려 손바닥이 앞을 향하게 하세요.
숨을 내쉬며 덤벨이 위에서 맞닿을 때까지 밀어 올리세요.
위에서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，坐在有靠背的推举凳上，把哑铃竖放在大腿上。
借助大腿发力，逐个把哑铃举到肩部高度。
转动手腕使掌心朝前，这是起始姿势。
呼气，把哑铃向上推，直到在顶端相碰。
顶端稍停后吸气，缓慢放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Sit on an exercise bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of you at about upper chest level with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent. Tip: Your arms should be next to your torso. The starting position should look like the contracted portion of a dumbbell curl.
Now to perform the movement, raise the dumbbells as you rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
Continue lifting the dumbbells until your arms are extended above you in straight arm position. Breathe out as you perform this portion of the movement.

After a second pause at the top, begin to lower the dumbbells to the original position by rotating the palms of your hands towards you. Tip: The left arm will be rotated in a counter clockwise manner while the right one will be rotated clockwise. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 등받이가 있는 벤치에 앉아, 손바닥이 몸 쪽을 향하게 덤벨 두 개를 윗가슴 높이로 드세요. 팔꿈치는 굽혀 몸통 옆에 붙이고, 덤벨 컬의 꼭대기 자세처럼 만드세요.
덤벨을 올리면서 손바닥이 앞을 향하도록 돌리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 팔이 머리 위로 곧게 펴질 때까지 계속 올리세요.
위에서 1초 멈춘 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 손바닥을 다시 몸 쪽으로 돌리면서 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 坐在有靠背的凳子上，掌心朝向身体，把两只哑铃举在上胸高度。肘部弯曲贴近躯干，就像哑铃弯举的顶端姿势。
向上推哑铃的同时转动手掌，直到掌心朝前。
呼气，继续上推，直到手臂在头顶伸直。
顶端停 1 秒后吸气，一边把掌心转回朝向自己，一边下放到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Sit down on the Shoulder Press Machine and select the weight.
Grab the handles to your sides as you keep the elbows bent and in line with your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now lift the handles as you exhale and you extend the arms fully. At the top of the position make sure that you hold the contraction for a second.
Lower the handles slowly back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 숄더프레스 머신에 앉아 무게를 정하세요.
팔꿈치를 굽혀 몸통과 일직선이 되게 한 채 양옆의 손잡이를 잡으세요.
숨을 내쉬며 팔이 다 펴질 때까지 손잡이를 밀어 올리고, 위에서 1초 버티세요.
숨을 들이마시며 손잡이를 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 坐在推肩器上，选好重量。
握住两侧把手，肘部弯曲并与躯干成一线，这是起始姿势。
呼气，向上推起把手直到手臂完全伸直，顶端保持 1 秒。
吸气，缓慢把把手放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells by your side at arms length with the palms of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso in a stationary position (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 덤벨 두 개를 들고 상체를 곧게 세운 채, 팔을 몸 옆으로 내리고 손바닥이 몸 쪽을 향하게 서세요.
상체를 흔들지 말고, 팔꿈치를 살짝 굽힌 채 컵에 물을 따르듯 손을 살짝 앞으로 기울이며 덤벨을 옆으로 드세요. 팔이 바닥과 평행이 될 때까지 숨을 내쉬며 올리고 1초 멈추세요.
숨을 들이마시며 덤벨을 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，上身挺直站立，手臂垂在体侧，掌心朝向身体。
躯干不动、不要摆动，肘部微屈，手像往杯子里倒水一样略向前倾，把哑铃向两侧举起。呼气上举到手臂与地面平行，顶端停 1 秒。
吸气，缓慢把哑铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs. This will be your starting position.

While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the left dumbbell to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down. Continue to go up until you arm is slightly above parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top. Inhale after the second pause.
Now lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the starting position as you simultaneously lift the right dumbbell.
Continue alternating in this fashion until all of the recommended amount of repetitions have been performed for each arm.
ko: 덤벨 두 개를 들고 상체를 곧게 세운 채, 덤벨을 허벅지 앞에 두고 손바닥이 허벅지를 향하게 서세요.
상체를 흔들지 말고, 팔꿈치를 살짝 굽힌 채 손바닥이 아래를 향하게 왼쪽 덤벨을 앞으로 드세요. 팔이 바닥과 평행보다 조금 높을 때까지 숨을 내쉬며 올리고 1초 멈추세요.
왼쪽 덤벨을 천천히 내리면서 동시에 오른쪽 덤벨을 올리세요.
이렇게 번갈아 가며 양팔 모두 정해진 횟수를 채우세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，上身挺直站立，哑铃放在大腿前方，掌心朝向大腿。
躯干不动、不要摆动，肘部微屈、掌心始终朝下，把左侧哑铃向前举起。呼气上举到略高于水平，顶端停 1 秒。
缓慢放下左侧哑铃，同时举起右侧哑铃。
如此交替，直到双臂都完成建议次数。

en: To begin, lie down on an incline bench with the chest and stomach pressing against the incline. Have the dumbbells in each hand with the palms facing each other (neutral grip).

Extend the arms in front of you so that they are perpendicular to the angle of the bench. The legs should be stationary while applying pressure with the ball of your toes. This is the starting position.

Maintaining the slight bend of the elbows, move the weights out and away from each other (to the side) in an arc motion while exhaling. Tip: Try to squeeze your shoulder blades together to get the best results from this exercise.
The arms should be elevated until they are parallel to the floor.
Feel the contraction and slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 인클라인 벤치에 가슴과 배를 대고 엎드려, 손바닥이 서로 마주 보게 양손에 덤벨을 드세요.
팔을 벤치 각도와 수직이 되게 앞으로 뻗으세요. 다리는 고정하고 발가락 앞쪽으로 바닥을 누르세요.
팔꿈치를 살짝 굽힌 채 숨을 내쉬며 덤벨을 호를 그리며 양옆으로 벌리세요. 견갑골을 모으는 데 집중하세요.
팔이 바닥과 평행이 될 때까지 올리세요.
수축을 느낀 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 胸腹贴住上斜凳俯卧，双手各持一只哑铃，掌心相对。
手臂向前伸出，与凳面角度垂直。双腿固定，用前脚掌撑地，这是起始姿势。
保持肘部微屈，呼气，沿弧线把哑铃向两侧打开。尽量夹紧肩胛骨。
手臂抬到与地面平行。
感受收缩，然后吸气，缓慢放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Adjust the handles so that they are fully to the rear. Make an appropriate weight selection and adjust the seat height so the handles are at shoulder level. Grasp the handles with your hands facing inwards. This will be your starting position.
In a semicircular motion, pull your hands out to your side and back, contracting your rear delts.
Keep your arms slightly bent throughout the movement, with all of the motion occurring at the shoulder joint.
Pause at the rear of the movement, and slowly return the weight to the starting position.
ko: 손잡이를 최대한 뒤쪽으로 맞추고, 무게를 정한 뒤 손잡이가 어깨 높이에 오도록 의자를 조절하세요. 손바닥이 안쪽을 향하게 손잡이를 잡으세요.
반원을 그리며 손을 옆과 뒤로 당겨 후면 삼각근을 수축하세요.
동작 내내 팔을 살짝 굽힌 채 어깨 관절만 움직이세요.
뒤에서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 천천히 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
zh: 把把手调到最靠后的位置，选好重量，调整座椅使把手与肩同高，掌心朝内握住把手，这是起始姿势。
以半圆轨迹把双手向两侧和后方拉开，收缩三角肌后束。
全程手臂微屈，只有肩关节活动。
在后方稍停，再缓慢回到起始位置。

en: Facing a high pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, pull the weight directly towards your face, separating your hands as you do so. Keep your upper arms parallel to the ground.
ko: 로프나 양손 손잡이를 단 높은 도르래를 마주 보고, 양손을 벌리면서 무게를 얼굴 쪽으로 곧게 당기세요. 위팔은 바닥과 평행을 유지하세요.
zh: 面对挂有绳索或双把手的高位滑轮，把重量直接拉向面部，同时双手向两侧分开。上臂保持与地面平行。

en: Grasp a barbell with an overhand grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The bar should be resting on the top of your thighs with your arms extended and a slight bend in your elbows. Your back should also be straight. This will be your starting position.

Now exhale and use the sides of your shoulders to lift the bar, raising your elbows up and to the side. Keep the bar close to your body as you raise it. Continue to lift the bar until it nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion, and should always be higher than your forearms. Remember to keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 어깨너비보다 조금 좁게 오버핸드로 바벨을 잡으세요. 바는 허벅지 위에, 팔은 펴되 팔꿈치는 살짝 굽히고 등은 곧게 펴세요.
숨을 내쉬며 어깨 옆 근육으로 팔꿈치를 위·옆으로 들어 바를 올리세요. 바는 몸에 붙인 채 턱에 거의 닿을 때까지 올리세요. 팔꿈치가 동작을 이끌고 항상 팔뚝보다 높아야 해요. 위에서 1초 멈추세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바를 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 以略窄于肩的正握握住杠铃，杠铃贴在大腿上，手臂伸直、肘部微屈，背部挺直，这是起始姿势。
呼气，用三角肌侧束发力，肘部向上向外抬起带动杠铃上升。杠铃贴近身体，拉到几乎触及下巴。肘部主导动作，始终高于小臂。顶端停 1 秒，躯干不动。
吸气，缓慢把杠铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Begin with your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding the band with both hands.
Initiate the movement by performing a reverse fly motion, moving your hands out laterally to your sides.
Keep your elbows extended as you perform the movement, bringing the band to your chest. Ensure that you keep your shoulders back during the exercise.
Pause as you complete the movement, returning to the starting position under control.
ko: 양손으로 밴드를 잡고 팔을 앞으로 곧게 뻗으세요.
리버스 플라이처럼 손을 양옆으로 벌리기 시작하세요.
팔꿈치를 편 채 밴드가 가슴에 닿을 때까지 벌리세요. 어깨는 뒤로 젖힌 상태를 유지하세요.
끝에서 잠깐 멈춘 뒤 천천히 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
zh: 双手握住弹力带，手臂向前伸直。
像反向飞鸟一样，把双手向两侧拉开。
肘部保持伸直，把弹力带拉到胸前，全程肩膀向后收。
完成后稍停，有控制地回到起始位置。

en: For this exercise you will need a heavy rope anchored at its center 15-20 feet away. Standing in front of the rope, take an end in each hand with your arms extended at your side. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by rapidly raising one arm to shoulder level as quickly as you can.
As you let that arm drop to the starting position, raise the opposite side.
Continue alternating your left and right arms, whipping the ropes up and down as fast as you can.
ko: 가운데가 5~6m 떨어진 곳에 고정된 굵은 로프를 준비하세요. 로프 앞에 서서 양 끝을 하나씩 잡고 팔을 몸 옆으로 내리세요.
한쪽 팔을 최대한 빠르게 어깨 높이까지 들어 올리세요.
그 팔을 내리면서 반대쪽 팔을 올리세요.
왼팔과 오른팔을 번갈아 가며 로프를 최대한 빠르게 위아래로 치세요.
zh: 准备一根中点固定在 5～6 米外的粗绳。站在绳前，双手各握一端，手臂垂在体侧。
以最快速度把一侧手臂抬到肩高。
这只手臂落回时，抬起另一侧手臂。
左右手交替，尽可能快地上下甩动绳子。

en: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at a shoulder-width grip. The palm of your hands should be facing forward and the elbows should be close to the torso. This will be your starting position.
While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Tip: Only the forearms should move.
Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
Slowly begin to bring the bar back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 상체를 곧게 세우고 어깨너비로 바벨을 잡으세요. 손바닥은 앞을 향하고 팔꿈치는 몸통에 붙이세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 이두근을 수축해 바벨을 감아 올리세요. 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
이두근이 완전히 수축하고 바가 어깨 높이에 올 때까지 올린 뒤, 1초간 강하게 조이세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바를 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 上身直立，以与肩同宽的握距握住杠铃，掌心朝前，肘部贴近躯干。
上臂不动，呼气，收缩肱二头肌把杠铃向上弯举。只有小臂活动。
举到肱二头肌完全收缩、杠铃到达肩高，保持 1 秒并用力挤压。
吸气，缓慢把杠铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length. Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward. This will be your starting position.

Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps. Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고 팔을 내린 채 바로 서세요. 팔꿈치는 몸통에 붙이고 손바닥이 앞을 향하게 돌리세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 이두근을 수축해 덤벨을 감아 올리세요. 덤벨이 어깨 높이에 올 때까지 올리고 잠깐 조이세요.
숨을 들이마시며 덤벨을 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，手臂自然下垂站直。肘部贴近躯干，转动手掌使掌心朝前。
上臂不动，呼气，收缩肱二头肌把哑铃弯举起来，举到肩高时稍停并挤压。
吸气，缓慢把哑铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso.
The palms of the hands should be facing your torso. This will be your starting position.

Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight forward while contracting the biceps. Continue to raise the weight until the biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a brief moment as you squeeze the biceps. Tip: Focus on keeping the elbow stationary and only moving your forearm.
After the brief pause, inhale and slowly begin the lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 상체를 곧게 세우고 양손에 덤벨을 들어 팔을 내리세요. 팔꿈치는 몸통에 붙이세요.
손바닥이 몸 쪽을 향하게 하세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 덤벨을 앞으로 감아 올리세요. 덤벨이 어깨 높이에 올 때까지 올리고 잠깐 조이세요. 팔꿈치는 고정하고 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
숨을 들이마시며 덤벨을 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 上身直立，双手各持一只哑铃，手臂下垂，肘部贴近躯干。
掌心朝向身体，这是起始姿势。
上臂不动，呼气，把哑铃向前弯举到肩高，稍停并挤压。肘部固定，只动小臂。
吸气，缓慢把哑铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar. Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle (either have someone hand you the bar which is preferable or grab the bar from the front bar rest provided by most preacher benches). The palm of your hands should be facing forward and they should be slightly tilted inwards due to the shape of the bar.
With the upper arms positioned against the preacher bench pad and the chest against it, hold the E-Z Curl Bar at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the bar until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.
As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weight up until your biceps is fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder height. Squeeze the biceps hard and hold this position for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 프리처 벤치와 EZ바를 준비하고 EZ바의 안쪽 손잡이를 잡으세요. 손바닥은 앞을 향하고 바 모양 때문에 살짝 안쪽으로 기울어요.
위팔과 가슴을 패드에 대고 바를 어깨 높이로 드세요.
숨을 들이마시며 팔이 펴지고 이두근이 늘어날 때까지 바를 천천히 내리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 이두근으로 바를 어깨 높이까지 감아 올리고, 1초간 강하게 조이세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 准备牧师凳和 EZ 杠，握住 EZ 杠内侧的窄握位。掌心朝前，因杠形略向内倾。
上臂和胸部贴住牧师凳垫，把杠举到肩高，这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃，直到手臂伸直、肱二头肌充分拉伸。
呼气，用肱二头肌把杠铃弯举到肩高，用力挤压并保持 1 秒。
按建议次数重复。

en: Sit down on a flat bench with one dumbbell in front of you between your legs. Your legs should be spread with your knees bent and feet on the floor.

Use your right arm to pick the dumbbell up. Place the back of your right upper arm on the top of your inner right thigh. Rotate the palm of your hand until it is facing forward away from your thigh. Tip: Your arm should be extended and the dumbbell should be above the floor. This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Tip: At the top of the movement make sure that the little finger of your arm is higher than your thumb. This guarantees a good contraction. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to starting position as your breathe in. Caution: Avoid swinging motions at any time.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Then repeat the movement with the left arm.
ko: 플랫 벤치에 앉아 다리를 벌리고 무릎을 굽혀 발을 바닥에 딛고, 다리 사이에 덤벨을 두세요.
오른손으로 덤벨을 들고 오른쪽 위팔 뒷면을 오른쪽 허벅지 안쪽에 대세요. 손바닥이 앞을 향하게 돌리고, 팔을 편 채 덤벨을 바닥에서 띄우세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 이두근을 수축해 덤벨을 어깨 높이까지 감아 올리세요. 꼭대기에서 새끼손가락이 엄지보다 높게 하고 1초 조이세요.
숨을 들이마시며 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요. 반동은 절대 쓰지 마세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복한 뒤 왼팔로도 하세요.
zh: 坐在平板凳上，双腿分开、屈膝、双脚踩地，哑铃放在两腿之间。
右手拿起哑铃，右上臂后侧贴在右大腿内侧。转动手掌使掌心朝前，手臂伸直，哑铃离地，这是起始姿势。
上臂不动，呼气，收缩肱二头肌把哑铃弯举到肩高。顶端让小指高于拇指，挤压 1 秒。
吸气，缓慢放回起始位置。全程不要摆动。
完成建议次数后换左臂。

en: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand held at arms length. Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward. This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 인클라인 벤치에 기대 앉아 양손에 덤벨을 들고 팔을 내리세요. 팔꿈치는 몸통에 붙이고 손바닥이 앞을 향하게 돌리세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 이두근을 수축해 덤벨을 어깨 높이까지 감아 올리고 1초 버티세요. 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
숨을 들이마시며 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 靠坐在上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，手臂下垂。肘部贴近躯干，掌心朝前。
上臂不动，呼气，收缩肱二头肌把哑铃弯举到肩高，保持 1 秒。只有小臂活动。
吸气，缓慢放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Stand up straight while holding an EZ curl bar at the wide outer handle. The palms of your hands should be facing forward and slightly tilted inward due to the shape of the bar. Keep your elbows close to your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps. Focus on only moving your forearms.
Continue to raise the weight until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the top contracted position for a moment and squeeze the biceps.
Then inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 바로 서서 EZ바의 바깥쪽 넓은 손잡이를 잡으세요. 손바닥은 앞을 향하고 바 모양 때문에 살짝 안쪽으로 기울어요. 팔꿈치는 몸통에 붙이세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 이두근을 수축해 바를 감아 올리세요. 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
이두근이 완전히 수축하고 바가 어깨 높이에 올 때까지 올린 뒤 잠깐 조이세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바를 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 站直，握住 EZ 杠外侧的宽握位。掌心朝前，因杠形略向内倾，肘部贴近躯干。
上臂不动，呼气，收缩肱二头肌向上弯举。只动小臂。
举到肱二头肌完全收缩、杠铃到达肩高，稍停并挤压。
吸气，缓慢把杠铃放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a cable curl bar that is attached to a low pulley. Grab the cable bar at shoulder width and keep the elbows close to the torso. The palm of your hands should be facing up (supinated grip). This will be your starting position.

While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the muscle.
Slowly begin to bring the curl bar back to starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 상체를 곧게 세우고 낮은 도르래에 연결된 컬 바를 어깨너비로 잡으세요. 손바닥은 위를 향하고 팔꿈치는 몸통에 붙이세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 이두근을 수축해 바를 어깨 높이까지 감아 올리고 1초 조이세요. 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바를 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 上身直立，以与肩同宽的握距握住连接低位滑轮的弯举杆，掌心朝上，肘部贴近躯干。
上臂不动，呼气，收缩肱二头肌把杆弯举到肩高，挤压 1 秒。只有小臂活动。
吸气，缓慢把杆放回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Attach a rope attachment to a high pulley and grab with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).

Standing upright with the torso straight and a very small inclination forward, bring the upper arms close to your body and perpendicular to the floor. The forearms should be pointing up towards the pulley as they hold the rope with the palms facing each other. This is your starting position.

Using the triceps, bring the rope down as you bring each side of the rope to the side of your thighs. At the end of the movement the arms are fully extended and perpendicular to the floor. The upper arms should always remain stationary next to your torso and only the forearms should move. Exhale as you perform this movement.
After holding for a second, at the contracted position, bring the rope slowly up to the starting point. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 높은 도르래에 로프를 달고 손바닥이 마주 보게 잡으세요.
상체를 곧게 세우고 아주 살짝만 앞으로 기울인 채, 위팔을 몸에 붙여 바닥과 수직이 되게 하세요. 팔뚝은 도르래 쪽을 향해요.
숨을 내쉬며 삼두근으로 로프를 내리면서 로프 양끝을 허벅지 옆으로 벌리세요. 끝에서 팔은 완전히 펴져 바닥과 수직이 돼요. 위팔은 몸통 옆에 고정하고 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
1초 버틴 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 로프를 천천히 시작 자세로 올리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 在高位滑轮上装好绳索，掌心相对握住。
身体直立、仅微微前倾，上臂贴紧身体并垂直于地面，小臂指向滑轮，这是起始姿势。
呼气，用肱三头肌把绳索下压，同时把绳索两端分向大腿两侧。动作末端手臂完全伸直、垂直于地面。上臂始终固定在体侧，只动小臂。
保持 1 秒后吸气，缓慢让绳索回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Using a close grip, lift the EZ bar and hold it with your elbows in as you lie on the bench. Your arms should be perpendicular to the floor. This will be your starting position.
Keeping the upper arms stationary, lower the bar by allowing the elbows to flex. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Pause once the bar is directly above the forehead.
Lift the bar back to the starting position by extending the elbow and exhaling.
Repeat.
ko: EZ바를 좁게 잡고 벤치에 누우며 팔꿈치를 모은 채 드세요. 팔은 바닥과 수직이에요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 들이마시며 팔꿈치를 굽혀 바를 내리세요. 바가 이마 바로 위에 오면 멈추세요.
숨을 내쉬며 팔꿈치를 펴서 바를 시작 자세로 올리세요.
반복하세요.
zh: 窄握举起 EZ 杠，躺到凳上时保持肘部内收，手臂垂直于地面，这是起始姿势。
上臂不动，吸气，屈肘下放杠铃，杠铃到达额头正上方时停住。
呼气，伸肘把杠铃举回起始位置。
重复。

en: To begin, stand up with a dumbbell held by both hands. Your feet should be about shoulder width apart from each other. Slowly use both hands to grab the dumbbell and lift it over your head until both arms are fully extended.
The resistance should be resting in the palms of your hands with your thumbs around it. The palm of the hands should be facing up towards the ceiling. This will be your starting position.

Keeping your upper arms close to your head with elbows in and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semicircular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell. Breathe out as you perform this step.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 발을 어깨너비로 벌리고 서서, 양손으로 덤벨 하나를 잡아 팔이 다 펴질 때까지 머리 위로 천천히 드세요.
덤벨 원판을 손바닥으로 받치고 엄지로 손잡이를 감싸세요. 손바닥은 천장을 향해요.
위팔을 머리 옆에 붙이고 팔꿈치를 모아 바닥과 수직으로 유지한 채, 숨을 들이마시며 팔뚝이 이두근에 닿을 때까지 덤벨을 머리 뒤로 반원을 그리며 내리세요. 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
숨을 내쉬며 삼두근으로 덤벨을 시작 자세로 올리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手握住一只哑铃，缓慢举过头顶直到双臂伸直。
用双掌托住哑铃一端，拇指环绕握柄，掌心朝向天花板，这是起始姿势。
上臂贴近头部、肘部内收并垂直于地面，吸气，沿半圆轨迹把哑铃放到头后，直到小臂碰到肱二头肌。只动小臂。
呼气，用肱三头肌把哑铃举回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Start with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing your torso. Keep your back straight with a slight bend in the knees and bend forward at the waist. Your torso should be almost parallel to the floor. Make sure to keep your head up. Your upper arms should be close to your torso and parallel to the floor. Your forearms should be pointed towards the floor as you hold the weights. There should be a 90-degree angle formed between your forearm and upper arm. This is your starting position.
Now, while keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and use your triceps to lift the weights until the arm is fully extended. Focus on moving the forearm.
After a brief pause at the top contraction, inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고 손바닥이 몸 쪽을 향하게 하세요. 등을 곧게 펴고 무릎을 살짝 굽혀, 상체가 바닥과 거의 평행이 될 때까지 허리에서 숙이세요. 고개는 들고, 위팔은 몸통에 붙여 바닥과 평행, 팔뚝은 바닥을 향하게 해 90도를 만드세요.
위팔은 고정한 채 숨을 내쉬며 삼두근으로 팔이 다 펴질 때까지 덤벨을 들어 올리세요. 팔뚝만 움직이세요.
잠깐 멈춘 뒤 숨을 들이마시며 천천히 시작 자세로 내리세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃，掌心朝向身体。背部挺直、膝盖微屈，从腰部前倾到上身几乎与地面平行。抬头，上臂贴近躯干并与地面平行，小臂朝下，与上臂成 90 度，这是起始姿势。
上臂不动，呼气，用肱三头肌把哑铃向后上方举起直到手臂完全伸直。只动小臂。
顶端稍停后吸气，缓慢放回起始位置。
按计划次数重复。

en: For this exercise you will need to place a bench behind your back. With the bench perpendicular to your body, and while looking away from it, hold on to the bench on its edge with the hands fully extended, separated at shoulder width. The legs will be extended forward, bent at the waist and perpendicular to your torso. This will be your starting position.

Slowly lower your body as you inhale by bending at the elbows until you lower yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the elbows as close as possible throughout the movement. Forearms should always be pointing down.
Using your triceps to bring your torso up again, lift yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 벤치를 등 뒤에 몸과 수직으로 두고, 벤치를 등지고 서서 어깨너비로 가장자리를 짚고 팔을 펴세요. 다리는 앞으로 뻗어 허리를 굽히고, 상체와 수직이 되게 하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 팔꿈치를 굽혀 위팔과 팔뚝 사이가 90도보다 조금 작아질 때까지 몸을 내리세요. 팔꿈치는 최대한 모으고, 팔뚝은 항상 아래를 향하게 하세요.
삼두근으로 몸을 밀어 올려 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 把长凳横放在身后，背对长凳，双手以肩宽撑在凳边，手臂伸直。双腿向前伸出，髋部弯曲，腿与躯干垂直，这是起始姿势。
吸气，屈肘缓慢下放身体，直到上臂与小臂夹角略小于 90 度。全程肘部尽量内收，小臂始终朝下。
用肱三头肌把身体撑回起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: To get into the starting position, hold your body at arm's length with your arms nearly locked above the bars.

Now, inhale and slowly lower yourself downward. Your torso should remain upright and your elbows should stay close to your body. This helps to better focus on tricep involvement. Lower yourself until there is a 90 degree angle formed between the upper arm and forearm.
Then, exhale and push your torso back up using your triceps to bring your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
ko: 평행봉 위에서 팔을 거의 다 편 채 몸을 들어 올리세요.
숨을 들이마시며 천천히 몸을 내리세요. 상체는 곧게 세우고 팔꿈치는 몸에 붙여야 삼두근에 더 집중돼요. 위팔과 팔뚝이 90도가 될 때까지 내려가세요.
숨을 내쉬며 삼두근으로 몸을 밀어 올려 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 在双杠上用手臂撑起身体，手臂接近伸直。
吸气，缓慢下放身体。躯干保持直立、肘部贴近身体，更能集中刺激肱三头肌。下放到上臂与小臂成 90 度。
呼气，用肱三头肌把身体撑回起始位置。
按计划次数重复。

en: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a close grip (around shoulder width), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest. Tip: Make sure that - as opposed to a regular bench press - you keep the elbows close to the torso at all times in order to maximize triceps involvement.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your triceps muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.
ko: 플랫 벤치에 누워 어깨너비 정도로 좁게 바를 잡고, 랙에서 들어 팔을 편 채 가슴 위에 고정하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바가 가슴 중앙에 닿을 때까지 천천히 내리세요. 일반 벤치프레스와 달리 팔꿈치를 항상 몸통에 붙이세요.
1초 멈춘 뒤 숨을 내쉬며 삼두근으로 바를 밀어 올리고, 위에서 1초 버티세요. 내리는 시간은 올리는 시간의 두 배 이상으로 하세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
끝나면 바를 랙에 다시 거세요.
zh: 仰卧在平板凳上，以约肩宽的窄握距握杠，从架上取下，手臂伸直举在胸部上方。
吸气，缓慢下放杠铃直到触及胸部中段。与普通卧推不同，肘部始终贴近躯干。
停顿 1 秒后呼气，用肱三头肌把杠铃推起，顶端保持 1 秒。下放时间至少是上推的两倍。
按计划次数重复。
结束后把杠铃放回架上。

en: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.
Place your feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart.
Lean forward and place your forearms on top of your upper thighs with your palms up. Tip: Make sure that the front of the wrists lay on top of your knees. This will be your starting position.
Lower the bar as far as possible while inhaling and keeping a tight grip.
Now curl bar up as high as possible while flexing the forearms and exhaling. Hold the contraction at the top for a second and Tip: Only the wrist should move.
ko: 손바닥이 위를 향하게 어깨너비로 바벨을 잡으세요.
발을 어깨너비보다 조금 넓게 벌려 바닥에 딛으세요.
상체를 숙여 팔뚝을 허벅지 위에 올리고 손바닥은 위를 향하게 하세요. 손목 앞쪽이 무릎 위에 걸쳐지게 하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 그립을 꽉 쥔 채 바를 최대한 내리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 손목을 말아 바를 최대한 올리고 1초 버티세요. 손목만 움직이세요.
zh: 双手掌心朝上握住杠铃，握距约与肩同宽。
双脚平踩地面，间距略宽于肩。
上身前倾，把小臂放在大腿上，掌心朝上，手腕前侧搭在膝盖上，这是起始姿势。
吸气，握紧杠铃，尽量把杠铃往下放。
呼气，屈腕把杠铃尽量卷起，顶端保持 1 秒。只有手腕活动。

en: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack to just below shoulder level. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.

Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees and hips as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 안전을 위해 스쿼트 랙 안에서 하세요. 바를 어깨보다 조금 낮게 걸고 무게를 끼운 뒤, 바 아래로 들어가 목 바로 아래 어깨 뒤쪽에 바를 얹으세요.
양손으로 바를 잡고 다리로 밀면서 상체를 세워 랙에서 들어 올리세요.
랙에서 물러나 발을 어깨너비로 벌리고 발끝은 살짝 바깥으로 두세요. 고개를 들고 등을 곧게 유지하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 바른 자세를 유지한 채 무릎과 엉덩이를 굽혀 허벅지와 종아리 사이가 90도보다 조금 작아질 때까지 천천히 앉으세요. 무릎이 발끝보다 너무 앞으로 나가지 않게 하세요.
숨을 내쉬며 뒤꿈치로 바닥을 밀어 다리를 펴고 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 为安全起见，在深蹲架内完成。把杠铃放在略低于肩的高度并装好重量，钻到杠下，让杠铃落在颈部下方的肩后。
双手握杠，腿部发力同时挺直上身，把杠铃从架上抬起。
离开深蹲架，双脚与肩同宽，脚尖略微外展。始终抬头、背部挺直，这是起始姿势。
吸气，保持躯干挺直，屈膝屈髋缓慢下蹲，直到大腿与小腿夹角略小于 90 度。膝盖不要过度超过脚尖。
呼气，用脚跟蹬地，伸直双腿回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: To begin, first set the bar in a rack slightly below shoulder level. Rest the bar on top of the deltoids, pushing into the clavicles, and lightly touching the throat. Your hands should be in a clean grip, touching the bar only with your fingers to help keep it in position.

Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head and elbows up at all times. This will be your starting position.

Bend at the knees, sitting down between your legs. Continue down until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your knees aligned with your feet by consciously using your abductors to push your knees out as you squat.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the heel or middle of your foot as you straighten the legs again and return to the starting position.
ko: 바를 어깨보다 조금 낮게 랙에 걸고, 바를 삼각근 위에 얹어 쇄골 쪽으로 밀착시키세요. 클린 그립으로 손가락만 바에 걸어 위치를 잡으세요.
다리로 밀면서 상체를 세워 랙에서 들어 올리세요. 한 걸음 물러나 발을 어깨너비로, 발끝은 살짝 바깥으로 두고, 고개와 팔꿈치는 항상 높게 유지하세요.
무릎을 굽혀 다리 사이로 앉으세요. 햄스트링이 종아리에 닿을 때까지 내려가고, 무릎은 발끝 방향으로 밀어내세요.
숨을 내쉬며 뒤꿈치나 발 중앙으로 바닥을 밀어 다리를 펴고 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
zh: 把杠铃放在略低于肩的高度，让杠铃架在三角肌上、贴近锁骨。用挺举握法，只用手指扶住杠铃保持位置。
腿部发力同时挺直上身，把杠铃抬离架子。后退一步，双脚与肩同宽、脚尖略外展，始终抬头抬肘，这是起始姿势。
屈膝，向两腿之间坐下，直到腘绳肌贴住小腿。下蹲时主动把膝盖向外推，与脚尖方向一致。
呼气，主要用脚跟或脚掌中部蹬地，伸直双腿回到起始位置。

en: Stand holding a light kettlebell by the horns close to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Squat down between your legs until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your chest and head up and your back straight.
At the bottom position, pause and use your elbows to push your knees out. Return to the starting position, and repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
ko: 가벼운 케틀벨의 손잡이 양옆을 잡아 가슴 가까이 들고 서세요.
햄스트링이 종아리에 닿을 때까지 다리 사이로 앉으세요. 가슴과 고개는 들고 등은 곧게 펴세요.
바닥에서 잠깐 멈추고 팔꿈치로 무릎을 바깥으로 밀어주세요. 시작 자세로 돌아와 10~20회 반복하세요.
zh: 双手握住一只轻壶铃的把手两侧，贴近胸前站立，这是起始姿势。
向两腿之间蹲下，直到腘绳肌贴住小腿。保持挺胸抬头、背部挺直。
在底部稍停，用肘部把膝盖向外推。回到起始位置，重复 10～20 次。

en: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. You can place your hands behind your head. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing your knees and hips, sitting back with your hips.
Continue down to full depth if you are able,and quickly reverse the motion until you return to the starting position. As you squat, keep your head and chest up and push your knees out.
ko: 발을 어깨너비로 벌리고 서세요. 손은 머리 뒤에 둬도 돼요.
무릎과 엉덩이를 굽히며 엉덩이를 뒤로 빼고 앉으세요.
가능하면 끝까지 내려간 뒤 빠르게 시작 자세로 돌아오세요. 앉는 동안 고개와 가슴은 들고 무릎은 바깥으로 밀어주세요.
zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手可以放在脑后，这是起始姿势。
屈膝屈髋，臀部向后坐。
能蹲多深就蹲多深，然后迅速起身回到起始位置。下蹲时抬头挺胸，膝盖向外推。

en: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.
ko: 레그프레스 머신에 앉아 발을 어깨너비로 발판 가운데에 올리세요.
발판을 받치는 안전 바를 풀고, 다리가 펴질 때까지 발판을 밀어 올리세요. 무릎은 잠그지 말고, 상체와 다리가 90도가 되게 하세요.
숨을 들이마시며 허벅지와 종아리가 90도가 될 때까지 발판을 천천히 내리세요.
숨을 내쉬며 주로 뒤꿈치와 대퇴사두근으로 밀어 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하고, 끝나면 안전 바를 확실히 잠그세요. 무게가 실린 발판이 떨어지면 위험해요.
zh: 坐在腿举机上，双脚以与肩同宽的站距放在踏板中间。
松开托住踏板的保险杆，把踏板推到双腿伸直。不要锁死膝盖，躯干与腿成 90 度，这是起始姿势。
吸气，缓慢下放踏板，直到大腿与小腿成 90 度。
呼气，主要用脚跟和股四头肌发力，推回起始位置。
按建议次数重复，结束后务必锁好保险杆，以免满载的踏板落下。

en: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
ko: 머신 등 패드에 등을 대고 어깨 패드 아래에 어깨를 넣으세요.
발판에 발을 어깨너비로 두고 발끝은 살짝 바깥으로 두세요. 고개는 들고 등은 항상 패드에 붙이세요.
양옆 손잡이를 잡고 안전 바를 푸세요. 대부분 손잡이를 앞에서 대각선 방향으로 돌리면 풀려요.
무릎을 잠그지 않을 만큼 다리를 펴세요.
숨을 들이마시며 등을 패드에 붙인 채 무릎을 굽혀 허벅지와 종아리가 90도보다 조금 작아질 때까지 천천히 내려가세요. 무릎이 발끝보다 너무 앞으로 나가지 않게 하세요.
숨을 내쉬며 주로 뒤꿈치로 밀어 다리를 펴고 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복하세요.
zh: 背部贴住器械靠垫，把肩膀扣在肩垫下方。
双脚放在踏板上，与肩同宽、脚尖略外展。始终抬头，背部全程贴住靠垫。
双手握住两侧把手，解开保险杆（多数器械是把把手从朝前转到斜向）。
伸直双腿但不要锁死膝盖，这是起始姿势。
吸气，背部贴垫，屈膝缓慢下蹲，直到大腿与小腿夹角略小于 90 度。膝盖不要过度超过脚尖。
呼气，主要用脚跟蹬踏板，伸直双腿回到起始位置。
按建议次数重复。

en: Stand with your torso upright holding two dumbbells in your hands by your sides. This will be your starting position.

Step forward with your right leg around 2 feet or so from the foot being left stationary behind and lower your upper body down, while keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance. Inhale as you go down. Note: As in the other exercises, do not allow your knee to go forward beyond your toes as you come down, as this will put undue stress on the knee joint. Make sure that you keep your front shin perpendicular to the ground.
Using mainly the heel of your foot, push up and go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat the movement for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
ko: 상체를 곧게 세우고 양손에 덤벨을 들어 몸 옆에 두세요.
오른발을 60cm쯤 앞으로 내딛고, 상체를 곧게 세워 균형을 잡으며 숨을 들이마시고 몸을 내리세요. 무릎이 발끝을 넘지 않게, 앞쪽 정강이는 바닥과 수직으로 유지하세요.
숨을 내쉬며 주로 뒤꿈치로 밀어 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
정해진 횟수만큼 반복한 뒤 왼발로 하세요.
zh: 上身挺直站立，双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，这是起始姿势。
右脚向前迈约 60 厘米，保持上身直立和平衡，吸气下降身体。膝盖不要超过脚尖，前侧小腿垂直于地面。
呼气，主要用脚跟发力，推回起始位置。
完成建议次数后换左腿。

en: Begin standing with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips.

Step forward with one leg, flexing the knees to drop your hips. Descend until your rear knee nearly touches the ground. Your posture should remain upright, and your front knee should stay above the front foot.
Drive through the heel of your lead foot and extend both knees to raise yourself back up.
Step forward with your rear foot, repeating the lunge on the opposite leg.
ko: 발을 어깨너비로 벌리고 손은 허리에 얹고 서세요.
한 발을 앞으로 내딛으며 무릎을 굽혀 엉덩이를 내리세요. 뒷무릎이 바닥에 거의 닿을 때까지 내려가고, 상체는 곧게, 앞무릎은 앞발 위에 두세요.
앞발 뒤꿈치로 밀며 양 무릎을 펴서 일어나세요.
뒷발을 앞으로 내딛어 반대쪽 다리로 런지를 이어가세요.
zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手叉腰。
一只脚向前迈出，屈膝降低髋部，直到后膝几乎触地。上身保持直立，前膝位于前脚正上方。
前脚脚跟发力，伸直双膝站起。
后脚向前迈出，换另一条腿继续箭步蹲。

en: Position yourself into a staggered stance with the rear foot elevated and front foot forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, letting them hang at the sides. This will be your starting position.
Begin by descending, flexing your knee and hip to lower your body down. Maintain good posture througout the movement. Keep the front knee in line with the foot as you perform the exercise.
At the bottom of the movement, drive through the heel to extend the knee and hip to return to the starting position.
ko: 뒷발을 높은 곳에 올리고 앞발은 앞으로 내딛어 앞뒤로 서세요.
양손에 덤벨을 들어 몸 옆에 늘어뜨리세요.
무릎과 엉덩이를 굽혀 몸을 내리세요. 동작 내내 자세를 바르게, 앞무릎은 발끝 방향과 일치시키세요.
바닥에서 뒤꿈치로 밀어 무릎과 엉덩이를 펴고 시작 자세로 돌아오세요.
zh: 前后分腿站立，后脚垫高，前脚向前。
双手各持一只哑铃垂在体侧，这是起始姿势。
屈膝屈髋下降身体。全程保持良好姿势，前膝与脚尖方向一致。
在底部用脚跟发力，伸展膝和髋回到起始位置。

en: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).

Place the right foot on the elevated platform. Step on the platform by extending the hip and the knee of your right leg. Use the heel mainly to lift the rest of your body up and place the foot of the left leg on the platform as well. Breathe out as you execute the force required to come up.

Step down with the left leg by flexing the hip and knee of the right leg as you inhale. Return to the original standing position by placing the right foot of to next to the left foot on the initial position.
Repeat with the right leg for the recommended amount of repetitions and then perform with the left leg.
ko: 양손에 덤벨을 들고(손바닥은 다리 쪽) 바로 서세요.
오른발을 단 위에 올리고, 오른쪽 엉덩이와 무릎을 펴며 주로 뒤꿈치로 몸을 들어 올린 뒤 왼발도 단 위에 올리세요. 올라갈 때 숨을 내쉬세요.
숨을 들이마시며 오른쪽 엉덩이와 무릎을 굽혀 왼발부터 내려오고, 오른발도 왼발 옆으로 내려 처음 자세로 돌아오세요.
오른발로 정해진 횟수만큼 반복한 뒤 왼발로 하세요.
zh: 双手各持一只哑铃站直，掌心朝向腿侧。
右脚踏上高台，伸展右侧髋和膝，主要用脚跟把身体撑上去，再把左脚也放上高台。发力上升时呼气。
吸气，屈右侧髋和膝，左脚先下台，再把右脚放回左脚旁，回到起始站姿。
右腿完成建议次数后换左腿。

en: Put a barbell in front of you on the ground and grab it using a pronated (palms facing down) grip that a little wider than shoulder width. Tip: Depending on the weight used, you may need wrist wraps to perform the exercise and also a raised platform in order to allow for better range of motion.
Bend the knees slightly and keep the shins vertical, hips back and back straight. This will be your starting position.
